page: Eden Treaty Response structure and handling. Promise containing object with data, error, response, status, headers. data: returned value (2xx status). error: returned value (>= 3xx status). response: Web Standard Response class. status: HTTP status code number. headers: FetchRequestInit headers. Error handling requirement for type unwrapping. error() helper function. Type narrowing for error. Nullable data/error until guard. Stream response as AsyncGenerator. Server-Sent Events handling. Utility types: Treaty.Data, Treaty.Error. Questions: How do I handle responses? What's the response structure? How do I use utility types?
